meta.name: subagent-driven-development
meta.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解计划并让多个子代理并行推进开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你要按计划推进开发，希望让子代理并行处理独立任务
copy.tagline_en: Break down the plan and have subagents execute independent tasks in parallel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an implementation plan and want subagents to handle independent tasks in parallel

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 会按实施计划把每个独立任务交给新派出的子代理完成;每完成一个任务,就审查是否符规格、质量是否过关,最后再整体检查一次全部改动。它会用台账文件记录进度和裁决,除少数特定情况外不中途停下来问你。
howto.when: 当你已有一份实施计划、任务相互独立,且要在当前会话中执行时,会触发。没有计划或任务紧密耦合时不会用它。

say.text: 按实施计划执行,每个任务单独派子代理,做完就审查。
say.note: Claude 会启动逐任务派发的循环并记录进度。

say.text: 计划里有多个同类小改动,合并成一个子代理批处理。
say.note: 它会合并成一次派发并统一审查,加快速度。

say.text: 执行完计划后,用最强的模型做一次最终代码审查。
say.note: 最后会用最强的模型做全分支审查。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude executes an implementation plan by dispatching a fresh implementer per task, checking each against spec and quality, then doing a whole-branch review. It records progress and rulings in a ledger and does not pause between tasks except in specific blocking situations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you already have an implementation plan, tasks are mostly independent, and you're working in the current session. Not used without a plan or with tightly coupled tasks.

say_en.text: Execute the implementation plan; dispatch a new subagent for each task and review after each.
say_en.note: Claude starts the per-task loop and logs progress.

say_en.text: Batch the similar small changes in the plan into one subagent dispatch.
say_en.note: It combines them into one dispatch and reviews as one unit, faster.

say_en.text: After finishing the plan, run a final code review with the most capable model.
say_en.note: It will dispatch the strongest model for the whole-branch review.
